Historical Chatbot Arena infrastructure linked by the discovery directory; current comparison uses Arena methodology.

visibility_selection.method: Purposive high-visibility selection using official model-launch references, dedicated public leaderboards/competitions and dated GitHub repository participation. At least one source-backed visibility signal is required per added family.
visibility_selection.limits: Not an exhaustive ranking of global hype, social reach or benchmark quality. No comparable social/media time series was collected. Repository stars are cumulative attention proxies with age and project-scope bias; the Gorilla count is parent-project-wide. Different benchmark versions remain separate. No external suite was executed.
visibility_selection.priority_definition: Direct: transferable to business workflow, evidence or operational checks. Method: useful evaluation design. Context: broad capability context. These are maintainer assessments, not external validation.

transfer_priorities.title: Expert gold and atomic rubrics
transfer_priorities.action: Recruit procurement experts, freeze allowed alternatives and forbidden inferences, adjudicate disagreements and report human agreement before qualification.

transfer_priorities.title: End-to-end workflow reliability
transfer_priorities.action: Test document import, interpretation, human correction and blueprint export with repeated runs, environment identity, failure states and cost/time accounting.

transfer_priorities.title: Structural and Semantic Assessment
transfer_priorities.action: Report schema/tool validity, source support, semantic violations and downstream executable checks as separate outcomes.

transfer_priorities.title: Freshness, custody and disclosure
transfer_priorities.action: Use externally selected unseen families, date windows, protected answer custody, sponsor/data-access disclosures and versioned judge/adapter policies.
